look.why: A lush rainforest emerald green echoing the Southeast Asian forest canopy where this arboreal cat lives.

size.measure: nose to tail tip, about 1.8 m (body 0.69–1.08 m plus 0.61–0.91 m tail per ADW)

habitat.text: Dense tropical evergreen and deciduous forests from the Himalayan foothills across mainland Southeast Asia.

diet.text: Monkeys, gibbons, squirrels, slow lorises, deer, wild pigs and forest birds hunted in trees and on the ground.

facts.text: Rotating hind ankles let it climb down tree trunks headfirst and hang upside down beneath branches.
It has the longest upper canine teeth relative to skull size of any living wild cat—up to 4 cm long.

id.habitat: Hutan hujan tropis lebat dan hutan gugur dari kaki bukit Himalaya hingga daratan Asia Tenggara.
id.diet: Monyet, owa, tupai, kukang, rusa kecil, babi hutan, dan burung hutan yang diburu di pohon maupun di tanah.
facts: Pergelangan kaki belakangnya yang dapat berputar memungkinkannya menuruni batang pohon dengan kepala di bawah.
Memiliki gigi taring atas terpanjang dibanding ukuran tengkorak di antara semua kucing liar yang masih hidup.
